The deadlines for the following PhD and Postdoc fellowships has been extended to Jan 12 and Jan 15, respectively.

We seek candidates with a background in Human-Centered Computing, with an emphasis on Human-Centred AI, Human–AI Interaction, or AI in Education.

Best,

Michalis

We are seeking three PhDs and three postdocs in the following areas:

•

PhD fellowship in Human–AI Interaction and Learning:

•

PhD fellowship in Multi-Agent Communication to Enhance Human Learning:

•

PhD fellowship in AI Enhancement of Game-Based Learning:

•

Postdoc Fellowship in Multi-Agent Communication to Scaffold the Learning Process:

•

Postdoc Fellowship in AI Enhancement of Game-Based Learning:

Location: NTNU, Trondheim, Norway.

Application deadlines during Dec.

The fellowships are part of the AI Centre for Empowerment of Human Learning (AI LEARN) — one of six national AI centres of Norway (

). Additional PhD fellowships will also be announced in the coming months

Feel free to reach out if you have questions, and please share with your networks!
